arxiv.title: Phase-Conditioned Reward Shaping for Token-Efficient LLM Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: Extended reasoning can help language models solve complex problems, but long responses often contain both useful computations and redundant checks. Conventional length penalties encourage shorter responses without distinguishing the functions of intermediate steps. We propose Phase-Conditioned Reward Shaping (PCRS), a framework that combines phase identification with training-time reward allocation. We investigate two classification routes: PCRS-H with a hidden-state classifier and PCRS-T with a frozen text classifier. Our main text classifier implementation assigns overlapping reasoning, execution, and revision labels to native chunks, then uses these labels and exact repetition to adjust existing token penalties. We compare the completed configurations on six mathematical and scientific reasoning benchmarks and examine four reward-weight settings with the text classifier. Compared with a baseline using token-level length penalties, the default text classifier configuration reduces mean response length by 3.13%; sampled Pass@1 is approximately 62.07% for both methods, while oracle Pass@16 rises from 86.08% to 87.67%. These results show how phase-informed penalty allocation can reduce output volume and improve multi-attempt coverage without inference-time classification.
arxiv.titleZh: 用于Token高效LLM推理的阶段条件化奖励塑形
arxiv.summaryZh: 长推理输出中既有有价值的计算也有冗余的检查步骤，而常规长度惩罚不区分中间步骤的功能。PCRS将阶段识别与训练时奖励分配结合，给出两条路线:基于隐状态的分类器PCRS-H与冻结文本分类器PCRS-T;主实现为原生chunk打上可重叠的reasoning、execution、revision标签，再结合精确重复检测调整已有的token级惩罚，且推理时无需额外分类。在六个数学与科学推理benchmark上，默认文本分类器配置相比token级长度惩罚基线平均响应长度降低3.13%，采样Pass@1两者均约62.07%,oracle Pass@16由86.08%升至87.67%，说明按阶段分配惩罚可在不损单次准确率的前提下压缩输出并提升多次尝试的覆盖。
arxiv.reason: 后训练奖励塑形与推理长度控制，方向契合但增益幅度有限

arxiv.title: Where Should Models Run? A Collaborative Inference Framework for Embodied Intelligence in 6G
arxiv.abstract: Embodied intelligence systems rely on fast and reliable inference to enable real-time perception, reasoning, and control. Recent advances in large-scale artificial intelligence (AI) models, including Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, have significantly enhanced the capabilities of embodied agents in complex environments. However, deploying these models remains challenging due to the limited computational resources and energy budgets of robotic platforms. A fundamental question is where inference should be executed. Collaborative inference, which partitions models across end devices, edge servers, and the cloud, has emerged as a promising solution. Yet determining the optimal partitioning point remains an open problem, as it depends on wireless network conditions, model structure, and privacy requirements. This article reviews the state of the art in collaborative inference for embodied intelligence and proposes an edge-centric framework in which the edge coordinates model partitioning and execution. Through both simulation and real-world experiments over WiFi and 5G networks, we demonstrate that the optimal partitioning strategy varies with network conditions and model structure. We further identify latency-minimizing partition points for ResNet-101, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and OpenVLA-7B in collaborative inference between NVIDIA Jetson Nano or AGX Xavier devices and an AGX Thor edge server under varying wireless conditions. Finally, we discuss the future directions for collaborative inference in 6G-empowered embodied intelligence systems.
arxiv.titleZh: 模型应当在哪里运行？面向6G具身智能的协同推理框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 具身智能系统需要低延迟、高可靠的推理来支撑实时感知、决策与控制，而机器人在算力与能耗上的限制使 LLM、VLA 这类大模型难以本地部署，由此引出「推理应当在哪里执行」的问题。文章综述了将模型切分到终端、边缘与云端的协同推理研究，提出以边缘为中心的框架，由边缘侧统一协调模型切分点选择与执行，切分点取决于无线网络状态、模型结构与隐私约束。作者在 WiFi 与 5G 环境下结合仿真与实机实验，给出 ResNet-101、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、OpenVLA-7B 在 NVIDIA Jetson Nano/AGX Xavier 与 AGX Thor 边缘服务器之间的时延最优切分点，并讨论 6G 下的后续方向。
arxiv.reason: 具身智能与VLA部署属低分方向，仅沾边缘推理效率的边

arxiv.title: Unified Factored Representations Resist Catastrophic Forgetting
arxiv.abstract: This paper explores an unexpected connection between the quality of a neural network's (NN's) internal representation and its vulnerability to catastrophic forgetting. The representational forgetting hypothesis is that networks with unified, factored representation (UFR) can resist catastrophic forgetting without any modification to the underlying fine-tuning algorithm or network architecture. The key insight is that catastrophic forgetting may largely result from fractured entangled representation (FER): fine-tuning on only part of the input domain results in disruptive changes for other input patterns, because of how individual features are globally entangled. In contrast, if a gradient update is compatible with how a UFR network factors its representation, such an update may result in coordinated change across the input domain, alleviating catastrophic forgetting. Experiments in two domains provide evidence for this hypothesis: (1) an illustrative 1D regression task, in which UFR networks constructed by hand are compared against networks trained from scratch with SGD, and (2) an image-regression task with NNs previously shown to exhibit UFR. In both settings, UFR networks forget substantially less than their FER counterparts when repeatedly fine-tuned on UFR-compatible variations. Further experiments show that a training loss that distills UFR representations into fresh NNs reduces forgetting; along with several additional controls, these results help isolate representation as the critical factor. Together these results suggest that representational quality is an underappreciated contributor to catastrophic forgetting, and that the encouragement and maintenance of such quality may require attending to what patterns a particular NN is ready to learn.
arxiv.titleZh: 统一因子化表示能抵御灾难性遗忘
arxiv.summaryZh: 探究灾难性遗忘与网络内部表示质量的关系，提出「表示遗忘假说」：具备统一因子化表示（UFR）的网络无需改动微调算法或架构即可抵抗遗忘，而遗忘主要来自特征全局纠缠的破碎表示（FER），即仅在部分输入域上微调，就会破坏其他输入模式。在一维回归（手工构造的UFR网络对比SGD从零训练的网络）与图像回归两类任务中，反复进行与UFR兼容的微调时，UFR网络的遗忘明显更少；用蒸馏UFR表示的损失训练新网络同样能降低遗忘，多项对照实验将表示确定为关键因素。这表明表示质量是灾难性遗忘中被低估的成因，对持续微调与表示学习具有启示。
arxiv.reason: 灾难性遗忘与表示质量分析，与持续微调相关但实验并非LLM场景

arxiv.title: ProtLink: Sequence and Multispecies Graph Context for Protein Interaction Prediction
arxiv.abstract: Predicting protein-protein interactions (PPIs) from sequence alone is difficult, while known interaction networks may provide informative biological context. We introduce ProtLink, a sequence-conditioned graph-learning framework that combines frozen ESM-2 representations with protein interaction topology and orthogroup-mediated connections between species. We compare sequence-only models, GraphSAGE, a homogeneous graph transformer, and a heterogeneous graph transformer (HGT) for human PPI prediction. In an initial edge-level comparison, three-layer multispecies HGT with ESM-2 650M features achieves an average precision (AP) of 0.980 under random negative sampling, compared with 0.951 for the homogeneous transformer; its AP decreases to 0.878 with two-hop-preferred negatives. In controlled three-seed experiments, three-layer full-graph HGT obtains an AP of $0.9701\pm0.0022$, exceeding an orthogroup-only model ($0.9435\pm0.0094$). The corresponding two-layer comparison shows little additional benefit from non-human PPI edges, consistent with the greater message-passing depth needed to transmit their information. For human proteins excluded from training interactions, multispecies HGT achieves $0.8335\pm0.0094$ AP versus $0.6482\pm0.0052$ for a sequence-only pair model. These results identify the value, depth dependence, and limits of evolutionary graph context while distinguishing prediction of held-out edges from generalization to held-out proteins.
arxiv.comment: Submitted to AI for Scientific Research at AAAI 2027
arxiv.titleZh: ProtLink:用于蛋白质相互作用预测的序列与多物种图上下文
arxiv.summaryZh: 仅凭序列预测蛋白质相互作用(PPI)较难，而已知相互作用网络可提供生物学上下文。ProtLink将冻结的ESM-2序列表示、蛋白质相互作用拓扑以及直系同源群介导的跨物种连接结合起来，比较了纯序列模型、GraphSAGE、同构图Transformer与异构图Transformer(HGT)。三层多物种HGT配ESM-2 650M在随机负采样下AP达0.980(同构Transformer为0.951)，双跳偏好负采样下降至0.878;三seed受控实验中三层全图HGT为0.9701±0.0022，高于仅orthogroup模型的0.9435;对未参与训练相互作用的人类蛋白，HGT的AP为0.8335，纯序列对模型仅0.6482。
arxiv.reason: 蛋白质相互作用预测，属生物信息学方向，不匹配关注画像

arxiv.title: RoutingTrie: Metadata Routing for Constrained Generative Retrieval
arxiv.abstract: Advances in large language models and semantic IDs (SIDs) have brought generative retrieval (GR) into industrial applications. These systems must return items that satisfy request metadata constraints as well as relevance requirements. A catalog trie ensures SID validity, but filtering metadata only after generation wastes computation on rejected candidates and may leave too few eligible results. We propose RoutingTrie to incorporate metadata constraints before beam selection. RoutingTrie maintains one shared SID trie and builds a compact index for each metadata field using Dense Bitset or Sparse List. We derive a storage cost formula to guide the choice between these index representations for different field distributions. During decoding, field probes determine whether requested values occur below candidate edges and produce a combined mask that guides beam selection. Experiments on ShopTrie, our configurable synthetic benchmark, demonstrate compact storage and efficient CPU and GPU probing across diverse metadata distributions. In a production replay, RoutingTrie raises Hit@100 from 67.5\% to 96.1\%, a gain of 28.6 percentage points, with only 1.1 ms latency increase. We will release the ShopTrie generator, benchmark scripts, and RoutingTrie CPU and Triton GPU implementations to support reproducibility.
arxiv.titleZh: RoutingTrie：面向受限生成式检索的元数据路由
arxiv.summaryZh: 生成式检索需在满足相关性的同时返回符合元数据约束的商品，而仅在生成后过滤会浪费算力，还可能导致合格结果不足。RoutingTrie 在 beam selection 之前引入约束：共享一棵 SID trie，并为每个元数据字段用 Dense Bitset 或 Sparse List 建紧凑索引，同时给出存储开销公式以指导两种表示的选型；解码时用字段探测判断候选边之下是否存在所请求的取值，合并成掩码引导 beam 选择。在自建合成基准 ShopTrie 上验证了存储紧凑性与 CPU/GPU 探测效率，线上回放将 Hit@100 从 67.5% 提升至 96.1%（+28.6 个百分点），延迟仅增加 1.1 ms。
arxiv.reason: 生成式检索的约束解码工程，属检索侧增量改进，非核心方向

arxiv.title: Slim Foundation Models for Latency-Critical Recommendation Serving
arxiv.abstract: Click-through rate (CTR) prediction is a core component of recommendation and advertising systems. Large language models (LLMs) offer rich semantic priors that improve prediction quality, particularly in cold-start and long-tail settings. Injecting a full-scale LLM into a CTR pipeline is, however, prohibitively expensive at inference time: existing LLM-enhanced CTR methods avoid this cost by caching LLM outputs offline rather than serving the LLM online. We propose a resource-efficient pipeline, SlimFM, that makes online LLM-based semantic modeling practical: (1) dependency-aware structured pruning compresses LLaMA3-8B by 44% to a 4.5B-parameter backbone; (2) LoRA-based field-aware fine-tuning trains the pruned model to produce discriminative field-level semantic embeddings from lightweight textual prompts; (3) a semantic-guided fusion module injects these embeddings into the feature interactions of a conventional CTR model. Across four datasets and six CTR backbones, SlimFM retains over 99% of uncompressed-model accuracy while reducing inference latency by up to 3.4x relative to existing LLM-enhanced baselines.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向延迟敏感推荐服务的轻量化基础模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 解决在线CTR预测中直接部署全尺寸LLM推理开销过高、现有方法只能离线缓存LLM输出的问题。SlimFM采用依赖感知结构化剪枝把LLaMA3-8B压缩44%至4.5B参数骨干，再用LoRA做字段感知微调，从轻量文本提示生成有判别力的字段级语义嵌入，并通过语义引导融合模块把嵌入注入传统CTR模型的特征交互。在四个数据集、六种CTR骨干上保留99%以上未压缩精度，推理延迟相比现有LLM增强基线最多降低3.4倍。
arxiv.reason: LLM剪枝+CTR推荐，效率方向沾边但属推荐系统应用

arxiv.title: Learning Actionable Information Landscapes for Multimodal Active Sensing in Hawkmoths
arxiv.abstract: Animals integrate information across sensory modalities to guide exploration, suggesting that they maintain internal estimates of where actions are expected to reduce uncertainty. However, how such action-conditioned information maps are learned from multimodal sensory experience remains unclear, as previous studies have been largely confined to unimodal sensing frameworks. We introduce a multimodal predictive-coding framework for learning uncertainty-reduction maps from visual and mechanosensory observations in hawkmoth flower interaction tasks. A variational generative model trained on simulated environments recovers modality-specific information landscapes over the action space, capturing how visual patterns, surface geometry, and mechanosensory cues shape the value of exploratory actions. These learned maps are consistent with several features of hawkmoth behavior, including nonzero tracking offsets, probing along visual patterns, and geometry-dependent exploration. Applying the model to behavioral data from flower tracking and nectary search, we find that natural trajectories tend to occupy regions of high uncertainty reduction in these learned maps. Building on these observations, we develop an uncertainty-gated lexicographic algorithm that switches between information gathering and reward exploitation based on perceptual uncertainty. In nectary search, uncertainty gating improves learning relative to exploit-only, $ε$-greedy, fixed-time, and uncertainty-calibrated non-lexicographic controls, with better generalization and robustness to sensory and curvature shifts. These results link information landscapes learned through generative modeling to biological sensing and embodied exploration.
arxiv.titleZh: 为鹰蛾多模态主动感知学习可行动的信息景观
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究动物如何从多模态感官经验中学习「动作—不确定性下降」的内部映射：以鹰蛾采花任务为对象，构建多模态预测编码框架，用变分生成模型在模拟环境中从视觉与机械感官观测中还原出动作空间上分模态的信息景观，刻画视觉纹理、表面几何与机械线索如何决定探索性动作的价值。学习到的景观与鹰蛾行为的追踪偏移、沿视觉纹样探测、几何依赖探索等特征吻合，且真实行为轨迹倾向于落在高不确定性下降区域。基于此提出不确定性门控的字典序算法，在感知不确定性高低之间切换信息收集与奖励利用，在蜜腺搜索中相较仅利用、ε-greedy、固定时长及不确定性校准的非字典序基线学习更快、泛化更好且对感官与曲率扰动更稳健。
arxiv.reason: 生物多模态主动感知，与LLM后训练/Agent方向无实质交集

arxiv.title: Lightfoot: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Exact, Model-Free Document Deletion
arxiv.abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) improves multi-hop question answering, but deployed systems face two costs that research comparisons rarely measure: building the graph, and removing documents from it. We present Lightfoot, a GraphRAG system in which every entity, link, fact and synonym edge is a deterministic function of per-passage extractions carrying chunk-level provenance. Indexing makes one language-model call per passage, retrieval makes none, and deleting a document is a database operation with no model calls. On the full 11,402-passage MuSiQue corpus we verify that, after deleting 10% of the documents, the graph is identical to a fresh index of the surviving documents. We compare Lightfoot with HippoRAG 2, LightRAG and fast-graphrag under identical extraction, answer and embedding models on MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA and HotpotQA. Lightfoot builds the cheapest index on all three datasets, 26-31% below HippoRAG 2 and 3-6x below LightRAG and fast-graphrag. Against HippoRAG 2 it is significantly better on MuSiQue retrieval (+2.8 points recall@5 and +4.3 recall@10 on a held-out split) and on HotpotQA answers (+7.7 points exact match), and significantly worse on 2WikiMultiHopQA (-3.9 recall@2, -8.4 F1). Deleting the same documents took LightRAG 2,187 model calls and 3.7 hours; fast-graphrag has no deletion path. Code and per-question results: https://github.com/udayallu-ml/Lightfoot-GraphRAG
arxiv.titleZh: Lightfoot:支持精确、无需模型调用的文档删除的图检索增强生成
arxiv.summaryZh: GraphRAG 部署时往往忽略建图与删文档两项成本。Lightfoot 把实体、链接、事实与同义边都定义为携带 chunk 级溯源的逐段落抽取的确定性函数:索引每段落只调用一次模型，检索零调用，删除文档退化为纯数据库操作。在 MuSiQue 全量 11,402 段落上，删除 10% 文档后的图与对剩余文档重建索引完全一致;索引成本比 HippoRAG 2 低 26–31%，比 LightRAG、fast-graphrag 低 3–6 倍，MuSiQue recall@5 提升 2.8 点、HotpotQA 精确匹配提升 7.7 点，但在 2WikiMultiHopQA 上落后。对照组中 LightRAG 删除同样文档需 2,187 次模型调用与 3.7 小时。
arxiv.reason: GraphRAG 索引成本与可精确删除机制扎实，贴近检索系统落地

arxiv.title: PIA: Agentic Physics-Informed Runtime Anomaly Detection
arxiv.abstract: Runtime anomaly detectors for cyber-physical systems are either learned as black boxes from normal data, which miss stealthy manipulations that keep every signal inside its normal range, or derived by hand from physical models, which requires expert effort for every plant. We introduce physicsinformed agents (PIA), in which a large language model agent writes the detector itself as a set of physical residuals, such as pump characteristics, tank mass balances, and controller logic, and refines every candidate against normal operating data through an evaluation workbench before deployment. The result is a compact, human-readable detector that runs in milliseconds and names the component behind each alarm. On the BATADAL water distribution attack benchmark, PIA with Claude Opus 5.5 reaches an F1 of 0.878 on the test attacks against 0.504 for the strongest of six statistical and deep baselines, keeps detecting attacks concealed by replayed and offset sensor readings, and attributes every detected test attack to the attacked component. Ablations show that testing hypotheses against data is decisive: agents that write residuals from the plant description alone lose up to 0.28 F1, whereas agents that see only anonymized signals recover most of the physical structure.
arxiv.titleZh: PIA：基于智能体的物理信息运行时异常检测
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对网络物理系统运行时异常检测：黑箱学习漏掉信号仍在正常范围内的隐蔽操纵，手工物理建模又需逐厂专家投入。PIA 让 LLM 智能体直接写出泵特性、储罐质量平衡、控制器逻辑等物理残差构成的检测器，并在评测工作台用正常运行数据迭代筛选候选。在 BATADAL 供水管网攻击基准上，PIA（Claude Opus 5.5）测试攻击 F1 达 0.878，六个统计与深度基线中最优者仅 0.504，可检出重放与偏置传感器掩盖的攻击并定位被攻击部件；消融显示仅凭设备描述写残差会损失最高 0.28 F1，而只看匿名信号也能恢复大部分物理结构。
arxiv.reason: LLM 智能体做物理残差程序合成，但落地于 CPS 异常检测垂直场景

arxiv.title: GradReason: LLMs as Meta-Learners that Replace Training Epochs with Training-Data-Free Weight Updates
arxiv.abstract: Standard training recipes make a fixed number of passes over the training data, even when an epoch mostly adds mini-batch noise. We study whether a large language model (LLM) that reads the weight and gradient history of a run can replace some of these epochs with updates that compute no gradient and read no training image. In GradReason, an LLM agent is called every ten epochs. In a restricted sandbox, it analyses recent weight snapshots, epoch-mean gradients, and validation metrics, then submits a Python program that computes new weights and a plan marking each of the next ten epochs as data or virtual. A virtual epoch is kept only if it passes a forward-only check on 5,000 held-out validation images. In 120 runs on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 with three architectures, Claude Opus 5.5 used 32.8% fewer data epochs than the 80-epoch recipe at 0.31 percentage points lower test accuracy (95% CI -0.72 to +0.09; 0.94 points on ResNet-18), on the recipe's own frontier of data against accuracy. Unprompted, Opus averaged recent weight snapshots in every run. This choice produced the savings: a fixed rule with the same acceptance check but extrapolations from prior work saved 5.4% of the data epochs, and the same rule with averaging added saved 25.0%. The LLM's contribution is to find a working update within a single run; once found, a fixed rule implements it equally well. An Opus run cost 0.68 USD, but at this scale the agent's latency exceeded the GPU time it saved.
arxiv.titleZh: GradReason:让 LLM 充当元学习器，以无需训练数据的权重更新替代部分训练 epoch
arxiv.summaryZh: 让 LLM 读取训练过程中的权重快照、epoch 平均梯度与验证指标，每十个 epoch 生成一段不计算梯度、不读训练图像的 Python 程序直接算出新权重，并标记哪些 epoch 可用「虚拟」更新替代;虚拟 epoch 需通过 5000 张留出验证集的前向检查才被保留。在 CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100 三种架构的 120 次运行中，Claude Opus 5.5 比 80-epoch 配方少用 32.8% 的数据 epoch，测试精度仅低 0.31 个百分点。LLM 在无提示下自发平均近期权重快照，而固定规则加上该平均即可复现 25.0% 的节省，说明 LLM 的价值主要限于单次运行内找到可用更新;单次运行成本 0.68 美元，但延迟已超过其节省的 GPU 时间。
arxiv.reason: LLM 驱动的训练效率改进，思路新颖但结论削弱 LLM 贡献

arxiv.title: Elastic Representations via Hyperbolic Geometry
arxiv.abstract: Learned representations (or embeddings) are the foundation of modern machine learning systems, yet they are typically trained as fixed-size embeddings, without accounting for varying downstream resource or task constraints. Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) addresses this limitation by learning nested representations, but requires costly end-to-end retraining and does not support post hoc expansion, while Contrastive Sparse Representations (CSR) reduce training overhead via lightweight adaptors but operate at a 4x larger dimensionality. Additionally, all prior works restrict their framework towards compression only. In this work, we introduce Hyperbolic Elastic Representation Learning (HERL), a framework for learning dimension-adaptive embeddings (compression and expansion) through a lightweight adaptor without retraining the base encoder. Our key idea is to exploit the exponential capacity of hyperbolic geometry by learning a non-linear mapping from the encoder space to hyperbolic space. We train a simple MLP to downsample the representations before projecting them onto a Lorentzian and learn adaptive representations that respect the Lorentzian geometry. Our approach is model-agnostic and effective in both supervised and unsupervised settings. Through extensive experiments across image and text modalities, we show that HERL preserves downstream performance across a wide range of embedding sizes, exhibits smooth interpolation between dimensions, and achieves these benefits at a fraction of the computational cost. Code: https://github.com/arjunrkaushik/herl.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于双曲几何的弹性表示
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有嵌入通常为固定维度，Matryoshka表示学习虽能学习嵌套表示，却需昂贵的端到端重训练且不支持事后扩展，CSR则以4倍维度换取较低训练开销，且已有工作只做压缩。为此提出HERL:用轻量MLP将编码器输出降采样后映射到Lorentz双曲空间，借助双曲几何的指数容量学习维度自适应表示，无需重训练基座编码器即可实现压缩与扩展。在图像与文本模态的实验中，HERL在较宽嵌入尺寸范围内保持下游性能，维度间插值平滑，计算开销仅为原方案的一小部分。
arxiv.reason: 嵌入维度自适应方法新颖，但与LLM后训练/Agent方向擦边

arxiv.title: Differentiable Agent-Based Modeling for Multi-Echelon Supply Chains: Gradient-Based Optimization of Heterogeneous Policies at Scale
arxiv.abstract: Global supply chains rely on the interactions of thousands of heterogeneous agents, posing significant challenges for optimization. While traditional optimization often assumes homogeneity to ensure tractability, Reinforcement Learning struggles with sample inefficiency when scaling to high-dimensional state spaces. We propose a Differentiable Agent-Based Model for multi-echelon inventory management. By implementing stochastic dynamics via differentiable tensor operations, we enable direct gradient propagation through the simulation. We validate the framework by recovering theoretical Newsvendor optima without supervision. Crucially, we demonstrate ``Mass Personalization'' by optimizing 10,000 distinct agent policies simultaneously in seconds, achieving a 53% cost reduction compared to scalar baselines. Furthermore, we utilize gradient sensitivity analysis to generate causal heatmaps, accurately recovering inherent lead-time delays from the computation graph. This approach bridges the gap between simulation and optimization, enabling the efficient training of self-correcting Digital Twins.
arxiv.comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 2026 Annual Modeling and Simulation Conference
arxiv.titleZh: 面向多级供应链的可微 Agent 建模：大规模异构策略的梯度优化
arxiv.summaryZh: 多级库存管理要为成千上万个异构 Agent 同时做优化，传统方法为了可解性假定 Agent 同质，而强化学习在高维状态空间下样本效率低下。该工作把库存系统的随机动力学写成可微张量运算，使梯度能直接穿过整段仿真传播，从而对 10000 个异构 Agent 策略做批量梯度优化，秒级完成，成本比标量基线降低 53%；无需监督即可复现 Newsvendor 理论最优解。此外，梯度敏感性分析可从计算图中还原出真实的提前期延迟，生成因果热力图，指向自校正数字孪生的高效训练。
arxiv.reason: 供应链垂直应用，与 LLM/Agent 主线无交集

arxiv.title: Open Problems in Chatbots and Mental Health
arxiv.abstract: General-purpose chatbots are increasingly used for emotional and mental health support. They can be useful, but issues such as sycophancy, reinforcement of delusional beliefs, and poor crisis response create risks that are difficult for researchers to study and evaluate. In this paper, we review the most critical open problems for researchers and policymakers in the use of general-purpose chatbots and their effects on mental health. First, there are tractable problems in the controlled evaluation of chatbots: establishing the construct and ecological validity of evaluations, evaluating multi-turn interactions, and connecting evaluations to improvements in chatbot behavior. For example, conventional benchmarks that primarily rely on static datasets cannot establish chatbot safety, and novel simulation methods need validation. Second, researchers must connect their studies of chatbots and mental health to real-world evidence. This includes analyzing the chatbot products that AI companies and mental health practitioners have deployed, including their user interfaces and human review and escalation practices for user welfare concerns. However, clinical analysis opportunities afforded by real chat log data sharing are complicated by significant privacy concerns. Finally, we argue that researchers should take an active role in the construction and refinement of evidence-based policy through corporate and governmental decisions such as user protections, standards of care, protected access to user chat logs, data sharing between institutions, incident reporting, and post-deployment monitoring. Such behavioral evaluations, studies of real-world outcomes, and data governance depend on each other and must be addressed in tandem. We believe a coordinated research effort would have substantial real-world impact.
arxiv.titleZh: 聊天机器人与心理健康中的开放问题
arxiv.summaryZh: 通用聊天机器人正被大量用于情绪与心理健康支持，谄媚、强化妄想信念、危机响应失当等问题带来了难以研究和评估的风险。本文梳理了研究者与政策制定者面临的三个层面开放问题:受控评估需建立构念效度与生态效度、覆盖多轮交互，并把评估结论转化为行为改进，依赖静态数据集的传统基准无法证明安全性，新型模拟方法仍待验证;真实世界证据需分析已部署产品的界面设计与人工复核、升级机制，而真实聊天日志共享受隐私制约;政策层面应参与用户保护、护理标准、日志受保护访问、机构间数据共享、事件报告与部署后监测等规则的构建。三类工作彼此依赖，需协同推进。
arxiv.reason: 聊天机器人心理健康安全与评估议程，与评测方法学沾边但偏垂直应用

arxiv.title: Toward a theory of Evaluability
arxiv.abstract: Machine learning models, particularly large foundation models, are increasingly evaluated along multiple axes that are relevant for their usage. In addition to accuracy measures appropriate for the specific task of interest, measures capturing safety, calibration and fairness properties are often of interest. The classical approach to these problems assumes that the test set has been held out from the training process, an assumption that is increasingly harder to justify for large foundation models. In this work, we formalize a notion of evaluability without this assumption, and ask if it is feasible to evaluate black-box models in settings where our test samples may have been used during training. We study this problem under different settings, capturing different levels of access to the model. We first study the natural setting, where the evaluator only looks at the output of the model on the test set. We fully characterize the class of distributions where accurate evaluation is possible, and show tight upper and lower bounds on the sample complexity of evaluation. Our results show that black-box evaluation in this setup is feasible if and only if the distribution is close to being small support. We then consider evaluation algorithms that can query the model on additional inputs and demonstrate connections to self-correctors studied in program testing. Using these, we show that a small amount of query access can increase the power of the evaluator for natural distributions and concept classes.
arxiv.titleZh: 迈向可评估性理论
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对大模型评测中「测试集可能已混入训练数据」导致经典留出假设失效的问题，形式化了不依赖该假设的可评估性概念，并研究在测试样本可能被训练见过时能否对黑盒模型做出准确评估。在评测者只能观察模型在测试集上输出的自然设定下，完整刻画了可准确评估的分布类，给出样本复杂度的紧上界与下界，结论是:该设定下的黑盒评估可行当且仅当分布接近小支撑集。进一步允许在额外输入上查询模型，将其与程序测试中的自我纠错器(self-corrector)建立联系，并证明少量查询访问即可提升评测者对自然分布与概念类的能力。为数据污染普遍存在的场景提供了评测可行性的理论边界。
arxiv.reason: 评测可靠性理论，切中污染下的黑盒评估，但偏纯理论

arxiv.title: DPDP: Diffusion Policy-Steered Diffusion Planner for Offline Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: In offline reinforcement learning, diffusion models fill two roles with complementary strengths. Typically guided by a critic, a diffusion policy is value-aware and favors high-return, behavior-supported actions, but it is short-sighted: it never lays out the states it intends to visit. A diffusion planner is far-sighted, synthesizing such a long-horizon trajectory, but it is only behavior-driven at execution, realizing each planned transition using only offline behavior.Each is strong exactly where the other is weak. We introduce DPDP to bring them together at the planner's execution step, where a planned transition becomes an action. Reading the planner's inverse-dynamics executor as a posterior over actions: the environment's transition likelihood relates an action to the planned next state, while the behavioral prior determines its weight under the offline data. Replacing this prior with a value-optimized diffusion policy preserves the planned transition likelihood and favors valuable actions that can serve the plan. We target the resulting clean-action distribution in two ways. A training-free sampler composes policy and inverse-dynamics scores at matched action noise levels and applies Langevin correction; this route uses a shared action noise schedule and an approximately common terminal prior. A preference objective instead amortizes the transfer into a single diffusion executor. Across D4RL, DPDP improves the planner it builds on, staying competitive with reactive diffusion policies on locomotion and leading on long-horizon navigation.
arxiv.titleZh: DPDP：由扩散策略引导的扩散规划器用于离线强化学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 离线强化学习中，扩散策略经critic引导、价值感知强但短视，从不规划将要访问的状态；扩散规划器能合成长期轨迹却只按行为数据执行每一步。DPDP在规划器的执行步把逆动力学执行器视为动作后验，用价值优化的扩散策略替换行为先验，在保留规划转移似然的同时偏向能服务该规划的高价值动作；并给出两条路线：免训练采样器在匹配的动作噪声水平上组合策略与逆动力学得分并做Langevin修正，以及用偏好目标把迁移摊销进单一扩散执行器。在D4RL上优于其基座规划器，locomotion与反应式扩散策略相当，长程导航任务领先。
arxiv.reason: 离线RL扩散规划，D4RL经典控制，与LLM无关

arxiv.title: Hydro-Dataset: A Multi-Modal Open-Source Pipeline for Nordic Hydrological Research and Foundation Model Benchmarking
arxiv.abstract: Despite world-class snow monitoring by the Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute (SMHI) and Finnish Meteorological Institute (FMI), no station-anchored, multi-parameter snow benchmark dataset exists for the Nordic boreal domain. We present Hydro-Dataset v1.1, a reproducible open-source pipeline that harmonizes 582 SMHI meteorological observation stations across nine hydrological winters (2015/16-2023/24) into a CF-1.9 NetCDF product with 1.8~million annotated station-days. Six derived snow parameters, such as Snow Water Equivalent (SWE), snow phenology, melt rates, degree-day melt factor, rain-on-snow flags, and freeze-thaw cycles, supply benchmark-ready labels for hydrological foundation model training. ERA5-Land cross-validation (Pearson R=0.78, bias=-262mm) confirms observation-anchored SWE provides a more reliable benchmark than reanalysis for machine learning training.
arxiv.comment: Accepted for presentation at ICIP Workshop 2026 and to be published as part of the conference proceedings
arxiv.titleZh: Hydro-Dataset：面向北欧水文研究与基础模型评测的多模态开源流水线
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对北欧寒带缺乏站点锚定的多参数雪情基准数据集，构建可复现开源流水线，将 SMHI 的 582 个气象观测站跨九个水文年（2015/16–2023/24）整合为 CF-1.9 NetCDF 产品，含约 180 万站点日标注；派生 SWE、积雪物候、融雪速率、度日融雪因子、雨雪混合标志与冻融循环六类参数，为水文基础模型训练提供标签；与 ERA5-Land 交叉验证（Pearson R=0.78，偏差 -262mm）表明观测锚定的 SWE 比再分析数据更可靠。
arxiv.reason: 水文气象数据集与基准，属垂直行业应用，与 LLM 方向无交集

arxiv.title: Horizon-Scalable Q-Learning
arxiv.abstract: Learning accurate off-policy state-action value functions (Q-functions) from offline datasets becomes harder as the task horizon grows. One-step temporal-difference (TD) learning bootstraps after every transition, so small per-step errors accumulate along the horizon, and early states can be badly misvalued even when the TD loss is small. Multi-step TD shortens this chain by following the dataset trajectory for several steps; however, since the behavior policy is often suboptimal, every followed action adds a bias, and no fixed number of steps suits a whole trajectory. In this paper, we propose Horizon-Scalable Q-Learning (HQL), a simple method that enables accurate long-horizon value learning by automatically balancing between one-step and multi-step returns. HQL extends a target through a dataset action only when the critic values it at least as highly as the best-of-N actions sampled from the BC policy, and otherwise falls back to a one-step target. We show that this rule is a principled off-policy correction that needs no action densities, which makes HQL compatible with expressive flow and diffusion policies. Experiments show that HQL avoids the failures of both one-step and multi-step TD on a combination-lock task across horizons, and outperforms prior horizon-reduction methods on long-horizon OGBench and OCBench tasks.
arxiv.titleZh: 可随时程扩展的Q学习（HQL）
arxiv.summaryZh: 在离线数据上学习准确的state-action价值函数时，任务时程越长越困难：一步TD在每次状态转移后自举，单步误差沿时程累积，即使TD损失很小，早期状态估值也可能严重偏离；多步TD虽缩短误差链，但行为策略次优，每跟随一个数据集动作都会引入偏差，固定步数也无法适配整条轨迹。HQL在扩展目标时，只有当critic对数据集动作的估值不低于从BC策略采样的best-of-N动作时，才继续延伸目标，否则退回一步目标；该规则被证明是无需动作密度的off-policy修正，因而兼容flow与diffusion策略。在combination-lock任务上，HQL避免了单步与多步TD在不同时程下的失败，并在长时程OGBench与OCBench任务上优于已有的时程缩减方法。
arxiv.reason: 离线RL长时程价值学习，方法扎实但非LLM方向

arxiv.title: Think or Remember: The Exchange Rate of Agentic Inference
arxiv.abstract: Agents built on reasoning models resend their growing transcript at every call. Two transacting parties, not the model, decide what that costs: the client keeps or edits messages; the server decides whether earlier reasoning returns in the prompt and what its cache reuses. We define a cost model whose counts match an instrumented engine exactly; the architecture charges $c$ per token processed and $β$ per pair attended. Their ratio $P^*=c/β$ is an exchange rate between thinking and remembering: per token, processing dominates below this context length, a thinking regime, and attention above it, a memory regime. A policy change has a mechanical cost, incurred even if the agent writes the same tokens, and a behavioral one: it writes different tokens, changing cost and outcome. Serving alone can flip which policy is cheaper: on recorded Qwen3-8B ScienceWorld runs, dropping earlier reasoning costs 1.74 times keeping it when the server reuses generated states and 0.34 times when it reuses nothing. In live reruns, dropping it cuts correct HotpotQA answers by 9-23 percentage points on four models, at lower point-estimate cost. Comparing context policies means comparing systems: architecture and serving set the cost of the history kept and the work it induces.
arxiv.titleZh: 思考还是记忆：Agentic 推理的汇率
arxiv.summaryZh: 推理模型驱动的 Agent 每次调用都会重发不断增长的对话历史，其成本由客户端（保留或删改消息）与服务端（是否回传历史推理、缓存复用哪个部分）共同决定，而非由模型本身决定。工作给出与实测引擎计数完全一致的代价模型：每 token 的处理成本计为 c，每对注意力的成本计为 β，两者之比 P*=c/β 就是“思考”与“记忆”之间的汇率；上下文短于该长度时，处理成本占主导，长于该长度时，注意力成本占主导。在 Qwen3-8B 的 ScienceWorld 记录上，丢弃早期推理的成本会随服务端是否复用生成状态而在保留成本的 0.34–1.74 倍之间翻转；在线重跑中，丢弃历史使四个模型在 HotpotQA 上的正确率下降 9–23 个百分点。比较上下文策略，实则是在比较系统架构与服务。
arxiv.reason: Agent 推理成本建模与上下文策略，直击 Agent 与推理效率方向

arxiv.title: An Analysis of Reinforcement Learning with Function Approximation
arxiv.abstract: We address the problem of computing the optimal Q-function in Markov decision problems with infinite state-space. We analyze the convergence properties of several variations of Q-learning when combined with function approximation, extending the analysis of TD-learning in Tsitsiklis and Van Roy (1996) to stochastic control settings. We identify conditions under which such approximate methods converge with probability 1. We conclude with a brief discussion on the general applicability of our results and compare them with several related works.
arxiv.comment: This version of the paper corrects the one that was presented at the 25th International Conference on Machine Learning. We corrected condition (7) of Theorem 1 and its proof, as well as the importance-sampling update (11). We also made the assumptions of Theorems 1 and 2 more precise and revised the proof of Theorem 2, adding an appendix with the auxiliary results it uses
arxiv.titleZh: 带函数逼近的强化学习分析
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对无限状态空间MDP中最优Q函数的计算问题，分析Q-learning若干变体与函数逼近结合时的收敛性，将Tsitsiklis与Van Roy（1996）对TD-learning的分析推广到随机控制场景，给出使这类近似方法以概率1收敛的条件，并讨论结果的适用范围及与相关工作的比较。该工作为函数逼近下价值迭代类算法的稳定性提供了理论边界，是理解深度强化学习收敛性问题的经典参照。
arxiv.reason: 经典RL收敛性理论，与LLM相关方向无交集

arxiv.title: DM-Call: Decision-Model-Guided Function Calling with Cumulative Verification Feedback
arxiv.abstract: Reliable function calling requires Large Language Models (LLMs) to select appropriate functions and generate arguments consistent with user intent. However, syntactically valid calls may still be semantically incorrect due to inappropriate function selection or mismatched arguments. In this paper, we propose Decision-Model-Guided Function Calling (DM-Call), a framework that combines local schema validation with separate decision-model verification of function selection and argument correctness. For rejected candidates, DM-Call accumulates verification probabilities, binary judgments, and schema errors across attempts. A hybrid feedback representation further combines numerical probabilities with verbal correctness labels to guide iterative refinement without executing external tools. Extensive evaluation across BFCL and API-Bank (first-call) demonstrates DM-Call boosts function-calling accuracy versus direct generation, at modest additional cost.
arxiv.titleZh: DM-Call:决策模型引导的带累积验证反馈的函数调用
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对函数调用中语法合法但语义错误(函数选错、参数不匹配)的问题，提出 DM-Call:以本地 schema 校验配合独立决策模型，分别验证函数选择与参数正确性;对被拒候选累积验证概率、二值判断与 schema 错误，并用数值概率加文本正确性标签的混合反馈引导迭代修正，全程不执行外部工具。在 BFCL 与 API-Bank(first-call)上，准确率较直接生成稳定提升，额外开销有限。
arxiv.reason: Agent 工具调用可靠性，属推理期验证的扎实增量改进

arxiv.title: SWEET: Mitigating Spurious Feature Reliance in LLM Reasoning via Weight Editing
arxiv.abstract: Reasoning in large language models can be disrupted by simple input perturbations (e.g. adding irrelevant distractors), suggesting reliance on spurious correlations. Identifying and suppressing the spurious features involved in long chain-of-thought reasoning remains challenging. We introduce Spurious-feature WEight EdiTing (SWEET), a training-free method that combines counterfactual interventions with mechanistic interpretability to identify and suppress spurious-features. SWEET extracts token- and sequence-level behavioral directions from activation contrasts between original problems and their counterfactual variants - capturing local and global patterns of spurious reasoning. It then localizes the responsible MLP neurons and attention heads and suppresses their contributions along these directions through weight edits. Using only 20 original-counterfactual pairs for direction extraction, SWEET improves accuracy by an average of 11.8 percentage points on perturbed inputs and 2 points on original inputs across five open-weight reasoning models and five reasoning benchmarks. It also reduces the relative gap between original and perturbed accuracies from 17.6% to 2.5%. Analyses identify two recurring forms of spurious reasoning, i.e. over-integrating irrelevant conditions and overthinking, and provide mechanistic evidence that SWEET improves reasoning robustness by suppressing both behavioral directions.
arxiv.titleZh: SWEET：通过权重编辑缓解LLM推理中的虚假特征依赖
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对大模型推理易受无关干扰等输入扰动影响、依赖虚假相关的问题，提出免训练方法SWEET。它通过反事实干预与机制可解释性，从原始问题与反事实变体的激活对比中提取token级和序列级行为方向，定位相关MLP神经元与注意力头，并用权重编辑抑制其贡献。仅用20对样本，在5个开源推理模型与5个推理基准上，扰动输入准确率平均提升11.8个百分点、原始输入提升2个百分点，原始与扰动的相对差距由17.6%降至2.5%。分析还归纳出无关条件过度整合与过度思考两类虚假推理，并给出机制证据。
arxiv.reason: 免训练权重编辑提升推理鲁棒性，机制清晰、实验扎实

arxiv.title: JUBILEE: A Benchmark Environment for Off-Policy Evaluation in Debt Collections
arxiv.abstract: Off-policy evaluation (OPE) estimates the value a candidate decision policy would achieve, using only data logged by the policy already in production. In debt collections, unrecorded factors can influence both actions and outcomes. This paper presents JUBILEE, a benchmark environment built around a debt-collections simulator that generates million-loan panels with competing risks, rare recovery events, and hidden factors driving both outcomes and assignment. The evaluation includes an 80-run comparison of tabular and gradient-boosted estimators under two synthetic outcome mechanisms and a 190-run parameter grid. Independent policy simulations provide reference values with estimated Monte Carlo uncertainty for a synthetic reward score and for simulated cash. With hidden factors influencing action assignment, several tabular methods agree closely while underestimating the field-visit policy's score, an error that also appears with boosted models. Intervals from tabular doubly robust estimation usually contain the reference without hidden assignment dependence but mostly miss it when that dependence is present. Estimates from randomized decisions do not show the same large error, although their limited precision leaves policy choice uncertain. The decision consequences depend on how policy value is defined. The field-visit policy ranks last under the score and first under simulated cash, which excludes channel costs. Under cash, log-based estimators miss this best candidate in nearly every run with hidden assignment dependence in the paired study. JUBILEE supports reproducible study of these failure modes under specified collections mechanisms.
arxiv.comment: 28 pages, 3 figures, 35 tables. Code: https://github.com/alpha-synthesis/jubilee. Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24008544
arxiv.titleZh: JUBILEE：用于债务催收中离策略评估的基准环境
arxiv.summaryZh: JUBILEE 构建一个债务催收模拟器基准环境，生成含竞争风险、稀有回收事件与隐藏混杂因子的百万级贷款面板，用于检验离策略评估（OPE）在隐藏因素同时驱动动作分配与结果时的失效模式。评测覆盖 80 组表格型与梯度提升估计器对比、190 组参数网格，并用独立策略仿真给出带蒙特卡洛不确定性的参考值。结果显示：存在隐藏分配依赖时，表格型双重稳健区间大多无法覆盖参考值，随机决策估计误差较小但精度不足；且策略价值定义从奖励分数改为模拟现金流，会使上门催收策略从末位升至首位，基于日志的估计器几乎在所有运行中错过该最优候选。该环境支持对这些失效模式做可复现研究。
arxiv.reason: OPE 方法学有参考价值，但属催收垂直场景，与后训练/Agent 关联有限

arxiv.title: When Safety Becomes An Outlier: Understanding the Retention of LLM Safety Behaviors
arxiv.abstract: Safety-aligned large language models often lose their safety behaviors after fine-tuning, even when safety data are included. While this fragility is well documented, its underlying cause remains unclear. In this paper, we propose that formulaic refusal strings can function as outlier modes: narrow, weakly grounded response patterns that are easy to fit but vulnerable to subsequent updates. Controlled experiments support this account: fixed refusals are acquired much like arbitrary constant strings, in contrast to prompt-grounded natural responses. Motivated by these findings, we introduce Naturalness-Enhanced Safety Targets (NEST), a safety alignment framework that improves safety retention by constructing natural, context-aware safety targets that keep safety responses within the model's existing output distribution and grounded in semantics. We instantiate NEST in both supervised and preference-based alignment settings, using perplexity under the original model as a proxy for distributional support. Across multiple models and alignment regimes, natural safety targets improve both immediate safety and its retention under continued fine-tuning without sacrificing helpfulness. These findings suggest a practical principle for more durable safety alignment: construct safety targets that draw on the model's existing language capabilities and remain grounded in the meaning of each request.
arxiv.titleZh: 当安全行为成为离群点：理解 LLM 安全行为的保持
arxiv.summaryZh: 安全对齐后的 LLM 在后续微调中容易丧失安全行为，即使微调数据包含安全样本；这种脆弱性的成因此前并不清楚。研究提出，公式化拒绝字符串可视为离群模式：一种狭窄、语义根基薄弱、容易拟合却易被后续更新破坏的响应模式。受控实验支持该解释：固定拒绝串的习得方式接近任意常量字符串，与基于提示的自然响应不同。据此提出 NEST 安全对齐框架，以原模型困惑度作为分布支撑度代理，构造自然、语境感知的安全目标，使安全响应留在模型既有输出分布内，并实例化于监督对齐与偏好对齐两种设置。跨多个模型与对齐范式的实验显示，自然安全目标同时提升即时安全性与持续微调下的保持性，且不损害有用性。
arxiv.reason: 安全对齐保持机制分析与 NEST 方法，扎实命中后训练对齐方向

arxiv.title: Improving Analytic Constants via Interpretable AI-Guided Lean Proof Refinement
arxiv.abstract: AI agents are increasingly capable of discovering new mathematical results, yet their reasoning and generated proofs can be difficult to understand and verify. We introduce an interpretable framework for AI-guided mathematical discovery, focused on improving quantitative bounds on analytic constants. Our key insight is that existing proofs often contain slack in intermediate lemmas, which can be tightened without reconstructing the entire argument. To exploit this structure, we represent proofs as partially-formalized Lean blueprints: human-interpretable dependency graphs of definitions, lemmas, and theorems. An AI agent then iteratively refines the Lean code while preserving the blueprint's dependency structure, allowing local improvements to automatically propagate to a verified final bound. This interpretable structure allows humans to inspect the agent's refinements and understand how local improvements propagate to the final theorem. For Grothendieck's constant ($\mathcal{K}_G$), we obtain $$ \mathcal{K}_G \leq \fracπ{2\log(1+\sqrt{2})} - 10^{-17}, $$ an explicit numerical improvement over Krivine's 1977 bound. For Korenblum's constant ($\mathcal{K}_K$), we obtain $$ \mathcal{K}_K \geq 0.356565, $$ improving Wang's 2025 bound of $0.3554$. Our experiments demonstrate the potential of both partial formalization and iterative agentic refinement for interpretable mathematical discovery.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过可解释的 AI 引导 Lean 证明精化改进解析常数
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有 AI 数学证明往往难以理解与验证，且冗长证明的中间引理常留有余量。为此把证明表示为部分形式化的 Lean blueprints——由定义、引理、定理构成的可读依赖图，AI agent 在保持依赖结构不变的前提下迭代改写 Lean 代码，使局部收紧自动传播到经过验证的最终界，人类也能逐处审查改动。在 Grothendieck 常数上得到 K_G ≤ π/(2log(1+√2)) − 10^{-17}，显式优于 Krivine 1977 年的界;在 Korenblum 常数上得到 K_K ≥ 0.356565，超过 Wang 2025 年的 0.3554。该工作展示了部分形式化加 agent 迭代精化在可解释数学发现中的潜力。
arxiv.reason: Agent 驱动的 Lean 证明精化属 AI for math 扎实工作，与 Agent 方向相关

arxiv.title: Hybrid Source Code Change Impact Analysis
arxiv.abstract: Change impact analysis (CIA) helps developers identify code entities impacted by their initial changes. While several approaches for CIA were proposed, they still struggle with either low precision or low recall, thereby increasing manual effort for developers to verify the results. Furthermore, limitations in the used datasets and experimental setups can bias the results reported by many CIA approaches. In this paper, we first address the dataset limitations by manually labeling 1,931 changed code entities stemming from 263 commits of 22 open-source Java projects. Next, we introduce two variants of katIA, our code change impact analysis approach that combines static impact analysis with the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). The first variant uses a single prompt (katIA-SP) for refining an initial static impact set while the second variant uses three specialized agents (katIA-MA). The evaluation with our curated dataset shows that katIA-SP with Gemini 2.5 Flash achieved an F1-score of 22.4% when matching impacted entities by their fully qualified names (FQN) and 27.0% when matching them by their class and entity names (CE). The latter shows an improvement of 2.0 percentage points over the state-of-the-art. This score is further improved by katIA-MA which, using Gemini 2.5 Flash, yields an FQN-matching F1-score of 29.1% and a CE-matching F1-score of 33.3%. While these improvements come at the cost of increased median generation time from 0.570 s to 11.214 s and median token usage from 1,235 to 6,462 tokens, the improved performance justifies the additional cost. The comparison of three LLMs using katIA-SP finds that Gemini 2.5 Flash is the most consistent model. These results indicate that combining static impact analysis with LLM-based refinement, particularly with the multi-agent variant, can improve code change impact analysis.
arxiv.titleZh: 混合式源代码变更影响分析
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对变更影响分析（CIA）精度与召回难以兼顾、数据集与实验设置易引入偏差的问题，人工标注了22个Java开源项目263个commit中的1,931个变更代码实体，并提出katIA：先用静态分析给出初始影响集，再用LLM推理加以精化。单提示变体katIA-SP配Gemini 2.5 Flash在FQN匹配下F1为22.4%、类与实体名（CE）匹配为27.0%，较SOTA高2.0个百分点；三专Agent变体katIA-MA进一步升至29.1%与33.3%，代价是中位耗时由0.570 s增至11.214 s、token由1,235增至6,462。结果表明静态分析与LLM精化结合、尤其多智能体形式，可提升该任务的效果。
arxiv.reason: 代码智能与多智能体精化方向对口，但属增量改进、绝对F1偏低

arxiv.title: Interpretable Cyber-Physical Attack Detection in Smart Grids: A Leakage-Controlled Multi-Testbed Evaluation of Fusion, Robustness, and Observability Limits
arxiv.abstract: Cyber-physical smart-grid detectors are typically treated as black boxes and validated exclusively on clean, temporally shuffled datasets, which risk overly optimistic performance claims. This work presents a multi-testbed evaluation study built around an interpretable, time-windowed fusion Random Forest, adopting the pessimistic result whenever evaluation protocols disagree. (i) On a public paired cyber-physical dataset, shuffled cross-validation is optimistic: macro-F1 falls from 0.96 to 0.88 +/- 0.06 under rolling-origin temporal evaluation. A topology-free graph convolutional network (GCN) serving as a control confirms that this lightweight model is competitive on these splits. (ii) The adaptive and adaptive-joint feature-space attacks, which are infeasible as realistic grid manipulations, degrade macro-F1 to 0.67 and 0.34, respectively. Adversarial training and randomized smoothing partially restore performance, and a physics-constrained evolution-strategy evasion on the IEEE 14-Bus testbed shows the same vulnerability pattern. (iii) On real IEC-104 traffic, the cyber view reliably catches structural attacks (recall of 0.87 to 0.98) but largely fails on semantic value manipulation (recall of 0.11 to 0.35). An observability taxonomy on the IEEE 14-Bus system reveals that stealthy false data injection defeats all three observation views. (iv) On a full AC weighted least-squares state-estimation testbed, a forecasting-aided temporal test is evaded by slow ramps precisely where a rate-invariant physics-manifold test sustains detection at a common 5% false-alarm target. A full end-to-end evaluation on IEEE 118-Bus confirms the ordering but bounds its strength: the manifold test detects every trial down to 0.05 degree/step and 0.48 at 0.02 degree/step, against 0.14 for the temporal test. All code and benchmarks are released.
arxiv.titleZh: 可解释的智能电网信息物理攻击检测：融合、鲁棒性与可观测性极限的泄漏控制多测试床评估
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对智能电网信息物理检测器普遍被当作黑箱、且只在干净且时间打乱的数据集上验证，从而容易高估性能的问题，构建了以可解释时间窗融合随机森林为核心的多测试床评估。公开配对数据集上，打乱交叉验证的宏F1从0.96降至滚动时间评估的0.88±0.06，无拓扑GCN对照显示轻量模型在这些划分上具竞争力；自适应特征空间攻击将宏F1压至0.67与0.34，对抗训练与随机平滑仅部分恢复。真实IEC-104流量上，网络视角对结构性攻击召回0.87–0.98，但对语义数值篡改仅0.11–0.35；IEEE 14-Bus的可观测性分类表明隐蔽虚假数据注入可击穿全部三种视角，AC状态估计测试床中速率不变的物理流形检验在5%虚警下优于时间检验。
arxiv.reason: 智能电网攻击检测属能源垂直应用，与LLM方向无交集

arxiv.title: CoupledFlow: One-Step Neural Operators for Coupled Multi-Physics PDEs
arxiv.abstract: This paper introduces COUPLED FLOW, a new neural operator learning framework for multi-physics PDE systems that captures the co-evolution of multiple physical processes by modeling their cross-process interactions. Unlike existing neural operator methods that primarily target single-physics settings, COUPLED FLOW employs a novel structure-constrained flow matching algorithm to learn process- specific mean velocity fields conditioned on the full multi-physics state. This enables fast and accurate one-step prediction of coupled PDE systems that would otherwise require expensive numerical simulations. A key challenge in training COUPLED FLOW however lies in sampling structure-constrained conditional flow interpolants that capture cross-process correlations and serve as training examples for flow matching. To address this challenge, we derive a multi-physics mean-flow consistency identity that characterizes cross-process interactions and defines the structure-constrained mean-flow matching loss. To provide informative training samples for flow matching with this loss, we develop a principled method for sampling correlated conditional interpolants based on posterior multi-output Gaus- sian processes, which capture richer cross-process correlations than the commonly used endpoint-conditioned linear interpolants. We also establish a theoretical re- sult showing that the Wasserstein-2 distance between the predicted and oracle PDE solution distributions is upper-bounded in terms of the structure-constrained flow matching loss and the smoothness of the learned flow. Experiments across diverse coupled PDE benchmarks demonstrate that COUPLED FLOW consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art neural operators and generative PDE solvers.
arxiv.titleZh: CoupledFlow：面向耦合多物理场 PDE 的单步神经算子
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有多数神经算子只面向单一物理场，难以刻画多个物理过程共同演化时的跨过程耦合。CoupledFlow 用结构约束流匹配学习以完整多物理状态为条件的各物理过程平均速度场，并推导多物理平均流一致性恒等式来定义结构约束平均流匹配损失；为提供有效训练样本，基于后验多输出高斯过程采样相关条件插值，比常用的端点条件线性插值包含更丰富的跨过程相关性。理论部分证明预测分布与真实 PDE 解分布间的 Wasserstein-2 距离以该损失和学习到的流的光滑性为上界；在多个耦合 PDE 基准上一致优于现有 SOTA 神经算子与生成式 PDE 求解器，实现快速单步预测。
arxiv.reason: PDE 神经算子与单步流匹配，与 LLM 关注方向基本无交集

arxiv.title: Can small transformers learn the language of Coxeter groups?
arxiv.abstract: The field of mechanistic interpretability is well-suited to collaborative projects between mathematicians and AI researchers. This work describes one such project. We trained a small transformer to learn the language of the Coxeter group affine A2, best known as the symmetries of the tiling of the Euclidean plane by equilateral triangles. We then formulated and proved a word-theoretic conjecture about affine A2 after observing the attention patterns of the trained model.
arxiv.comment: 13 pages, 13 figures, accepted as a poster at the 6th workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI; NeurIPS 2026, Atlanta; This version is updated from the camera-ready version which can be found at https://mathai-2026.github.io/cfp/ and https://openreview.net/forum?id=lYImtIt4tA
arxiv.titleZh: 小型 Transformer 能否学会 Coxeter 群的语言？
arxiv.summaryZh: 训练一个小型 Transformer 学习仿射 A2 Coxeter 群的语言，该群即欧氏平面正三角形密铺的对称群；通过观察训练后模型的注意力模式，提出并证明了一条关于仿射 A2 的词论猜想。这项工作把机制可解释性作为数学家与 AI 研究者协作的一种具体范式，展示了从模型内部模式反推数学命题的可行性。
arxiv.reason: 机制可解释性与数学结构交叉，选题有趣但规模小、属 workshop 短文

arxiv.title: Gendered Misclassification from Surname-Based Race Imputation
arxiv.abstract: Researchers increasingly estimate political behavior based on race and gender from voter files, where race is imputed from surnames and geography. This only works where surnames suggest group membership, an assumption violated where surnames follow norms around marriage. Imputation is therefore biased against women who adopt their husband's surname, especially those who racially inter-marry, an outcome itself endogenous to partisanship. Using six US states recording self-reported race, I show that imputation is less accurate for Asian and Hispanic women, particularly those sharing the surname of a partner of another race, who differ politically from other women of their race. This violates assumptions behind downstream inference approaches, which nearly double the gender gap in partisanship among Asian voters. I derive an expression showing the bias is largest where a group is small. Using maiden rather than marriage-adopted surnames in North Carolina raises accuracy up to fourfold for women married across racial lines. Recovering maiden surnames, or omitting the married surname, removes much of the bias. In a national replication of a study of gender gaps in turnout, the correction more than triples the gap among Asian voters. In Lebanon, where wives register in their husband's locality, the error enters through geography.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于姓氏的种族推断所导致的性别误分类
arxiv.summaryZh: 选民档案研究中常用「姓氏 + 地理」推断种族，再据此估计政治行为，但该假设在女性婚后改随夫姓的场景下失效。作者用美国六个州的自报种族数据检验发现，亚洲与西班牙裔女性的推断准确率更低，跨种族通婚者的误差尤甚，这会破坏下游推断假设，使亚裔党派倾向的性别差距被近乎翻倍估计；理论上该偏差在群体规模小时最大，改用北卡罗来纳州的婚前姓可使跨种族通婚女性的准确率最高提升四倍，全国复制实验中校正后亚裔投票率性别差距扩大三倍以上。
arxiv.reason: 计算社会科学中的姓氏推断偏差，与 LLM 方向无关

arxiv.title: DeepFinance: Can AI Diligence a $100MM Deal?
arxiv.abstract: Existing evaluations of AI models on high-finance work focus on retrieving answers from financial documents and producing numerically correct outputs. Real private equity (PE) and investment banking (IB) work also depends on choosing between conflicting sources, making sound assumptions, and keeping every step auditable. We introduce DeepFinance, an ultra long-horizon benchmark of 21 end-to-end PE and IB tasks that take a human professional an average of 27.1 hours. Each task pairs a request with a data room averaging 19 files and is graded against an average of 84 expert-written rubric criteria covering output, workflow, and judgment. We evaluate 22 model configurations, each in its native agent harness. The best configuration, GPT-6 Astra with max reasoning, satisfies 57.6% of rubric criteria, and the top four configurations are not statistically distinguishable. Frontier models often calculate correctly from the wrong inputs and find decision-relevant evidence without acting on it.
arxiv.titleZh: DeepFinance：AI 能否完成一笔 1 亿美元交易的尽职调查？
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有金融 AI 评测多停留在从文档中检索答案、产出数值正确的结果，而真实的 PE 与投行工作还要求在被此冲突的信息源之间做取舍、做出合理假设，并保证每一步可审计。DeepFinance 构建了 21 个端到端 PE/IB 任务的超长程基准，单任务人类专业者平均耗时 27.1 小时，每个任务配一个平均含 19 个文件的数据室，并由平均 84 条专家撰写的评分细则从产出、工作流与判断力三个维度打分。作者在 22 种模型配置各自的原生 agent harness 下评测，最强配置 GPT-6 Astra（最大推理）仅满足 57.6% 的评分细则，前四名在统计上不可区分；前沿模型常出现「输入选错但计算正确」「找到关键证据却不据此行动」的失败模式。该基准把 agent 评测推向长程、多源冲突与流程可审计的专业工作场景。
arxiv.reason: 长程 agent 评测基准有价值，但落在金融垂直场景，分量中等

arxiv.title: Prescriptive Learning of Linear Policies with Feasibility Guarantees for Binary Decision-Making
arxiv.abstract: Binary decision-making under uncertainty arises across a wide range of applications, including energy systems scheduling, transportation, and workforce planning. While machine learning has been increasingly applied to accelerate or replace mixed-integer solvers in such settings, existing approaches rely on predictive learning, training models to reproduce optimal decisions from labeled data, which lacks knowledge of counterfactual outcomes and provides no guarantees that the resulting decisions will be feasible. This limitation is further compounded under distributional shift, where policies trained on historical data may produce systematically infeasible decisions. We propose a prescriptive learning framework for binary decision-making that addresses both limitations. Rather than predicting optimal labels, the framework jointly optimizes over linear decision policies and feasible assignments across all training scenarios, allowing feasible alternatives and their operational performance to be considered directly during training. We further extend the framework to a distributionally robust chance-constrained formulation using a Wasserstein ambiguity set, which enforces feasibility with a prescribed probability under the worst-case distribution in the ambiguity set and enables a tunable trade-off between robustness and solution quality. We demonstrate the framework on two case studies, namely a unit commitment problem and a staff allocation problem. Out-of-sample experiments under test distributions that either match or differ from the training distribution show that the robust model is more conservative when the two distributions coincide, while under distributional shift it substantially reduces unmet demand and lowers total cost by up to 76.5% relative to classical predictive learning.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向二值决策的、带可行性保证的线性策略规定性学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对混合整数决策中预测式学习只复现历史最优标签、无法保证可行性且分布偏移下易系统性不可行的问题，提出联合优化线性决策策略与所有训练场景可行分配的规定性学习框架，并扩展为基于Wasserstein模糊集的分布鲁棒机会约束形式，以在最坏分布下按给定概率满足可行性并调节鲁棒性与解质量。在机组组合与人员分配两个案例中，分布偏移下相较经典预测学习最多降低76.5%总成本并减少未满足需求。
arxiv.reason: 运筹优化垂直应用，与LLM无关

arxiv.title: Pole or Vector? Encoders Capture Bangla Compound Verbs, but LLMs Read Them Literally
arxiv.abstract: In Bangla, a main verb is often followed by one of a small set of vector verbs. These verbs lose their own meaning and add a shade of meaning instead, such as completion. For example, likhe phello means that someone finished writing, not that they wrote and threw something. The same two verbs can also describe two separate events, so only the context shows which meaning is meant. This makes compound verbs a hard test of how language models handle multiword expressions. We present BanglaCV-Probe, a benchmark of 17 vector verbs with 1,044 minimal pairs, 204 entailment items and 197 pairs of correct and incorrect combinations, all checked by native speakers. We test 26 models (encoders, LLMs and translation systems) on four skills: telling the two meanings apart internally, understanding what a vector adds, preferring correct combinations and keeping the vector's meaning in translation. Probes on five encoders tell the two meanings apart and still reach up to 93% accuracy when trained on pairs without surface cues. Prompted models rarely use this knowledge. Entailment accuracy stays between 59% and 81%. Several LLMs answer Yes or No to almost every item, and nine of ten models miss that someone who ate up the rice left none. Most instruction-tuned LLMs translate vectors literally in 15-20% of vector sentences and in up to 55% for mora (die). On correct combinations, a small Bangla-only model (88%) matches BLOOM-7B1 (87%) and both beat Qwen2.5-7B (74%). Data and code: https://github.com/ashuvo25/Pole_OR_Vector
arxiv.titleZh: Pole 还是 Vector？编码器能捕捉孟加拉语复合动词，但 LLM 按字面理解
arxiv.summaryZh: 孟加拉语中主动词后接的 vector 动词会虚化语义（如 likhe phello 表示「写完」而非「写完并扔掉」），同一组合也可表示两个独立事件，需要依赖上下文消歧，是检验模型处理多词表达的难题。工作构建 BanglaCV-Probe：覆盖 17 个 vector 动词、1,044 组最小对立对、204 条蕴含题与 197 组正误搭配，全部经母语者校验，并在 4 项技能上评测 26 个模型。结果显示五个编码器的探针在无表层线索训练下区分两种含义的准确率可达 93%，但提示下的 LLM 很少调用该知识，蕴含准确率仅 59%–81%，多数指令微调模型在 15%–20% 的 vector 句上按字面翻译（mora 高达 55%）。正误搭配判断中，小型孟加拉语专用模型（88%）与 BLOOM-7B1（87%）相当并超过 Qwen2.5-7B（74%），说明低资源语言的组合语义仍是当前 LLM 的明显短板。
arxiv.reason: 多词表达评测基准，属方法学但语言范围偏窄，擦边

arxiv.title: SCorPion: A Strategic, Controllable and Personified Conversational Companion
arxiv.abstract: Fixed prompt-based language models face challenges in open-domain conversations, where versatile topics require different expert advice or demonstrations to maximize their universal performance. Motivated by the dynamic prompt studies in language generation, we extract different chatting strategies from varied forms of text corpus, which steer the language model to different styles based on human principles. We design and deploy a conversational companion called SCorPion, which uses GraphRAG to extract and summarize the knowledge graph globally, yield community-summarized strategies, and produce query-focused optimal strategies. SCorPion has strategic thinking, yields personified and stylized responses, and can be controlled by explicit factors. Code and further results can be found in https://bachozean.github.io/scorpion-page/.
arxiv.titleZh: SCorPion：一个策略化、可控且人格化的对话伴侣
arxiv.summaryZh: 固定 prompt 的语言模型在开放域对话中难以适配多样话题，无法为不同场景调用相应的专家建议或示例。工作从多种形式的文本语料中抽取不同聊天策略，按人类原则引导模型呈现不同风格，并用 GraphRAG 对知识图谱做全局抽取与摘要，生成社区级策略摘要，再针对具体查询产出最优策略。系统由此具备策略性思考能力，可输出人格化、风格化回复，并能通过显式因素控制。该方案为可控人格化对话伴侣提供了可检索、可组合的策略来源。
arxiv.reason: GraphRAG 驱动的人格化对话策略，方向擦边且为 workshop 短文

arxiv.title: How Short Is Too Short? Length-Conditional Calibration and Abstention for Detecting AI-Generated Text
arxiv.abstract: Detectors of AI-generated text are usually tuned and tested on passages of several hundred tokens, yet many real cases are short. We study score-based detection as a function of passage length. We give a closed form for how the false-positive rate of a threshold set on long text changes as length falls, and a formula for the number of tokens a detector needs to reach a target true-positive rate. We calibrate thresholds within length bins with conformal p-values, and we add a bin-level rule that abstains when the detector cannot be informative at that length. On synthetic scores the formulas agree with simulation, and binned calibration holds the false-positive rate at its nominal value at every length. On three zero-shot detectors (log-likelihood, log-rank, Binoculars), three corpora and two open-weight generators, binned calibration gives a mean false-positive rate of 5.0% in every detector-length cell from 10 to 200 tokens, averaged over 300 random document-level resplits. A single threshold set at 200 tokens gives 29% for Binoculars at 10 tokens and about 1% for log-likelihood, as the closed form predicts. No detector reaches an 80% true-positive rate, and the best, Binoculars at 200 tokens, reaches 59%, so the rule abstains in every cell at that floor and releases only the 200-token bins at floors of 0.3 and 0.5.
arxiv.titleZh: 多短才算太短?AI生成文本检测的长度条件校准与弃答
arxiv.summaryZh: AI生成文本检测器通常在数百token的长文本上调试与测试，而真实场景中的文本往往很短，阈值随之失效。工作给出闭式公式刻画长文本阈值在长度缩短时假阳性率的变化，以及达到目标真阳性率所需token数的估计;并在长度分箱内用conformal p值校准阈值，附一条分箱级弃答规则，在检测器于该长度无法提供有效信息时拒绝判定。在log-likelihood、log-rank、Binoculars三种零样本检测器、三个语料与两个开源权重生成器上，分箱校准使10至200 token各单元格的平均假阳性率稳定在5.0%，而以200 token设定的单一阈值在10 token处对Binoculars高达29%;同时无检测器达到80%真阳性率，最佳者(Binoculars,200 token)仅59%，故该规则在0.8下限下全部弃答。适用于短文本AI内容检测的阈值设定与可靠性评估。
arxiv.reason: AI生成文本检测的长度校准与弃答，方法学沾边但非核心方向

arxiv.title: Optimal Byzantine-resilient Federated Learning with User-level Differential Privacy
arxiv.abstract: Real-world deployment of federated learning (FL) requires resilience against adversarial clients and data privacy. Byzantine fault captures the worst-case behavior of adversarial clients, while differential privacy (DP) provides statistical guarantees against privacy loss. In particular, user-level DP guards a client's entire contribution and provides more realistic protection against information leakage. Despite intensive efforts, the minimax-optimal convergence bound of Byzantine-resilient FL with user-level DP remains open. We establish an information-theoretic lower bound for any Byzantine-resilient empirical risk minimization problem under user-level DP and heterogeneous clients. We propose ByzULDP, a central DP algorithm featuring a two-level momentum across the client and server. Client-side momentum mitigates stochastic gradient variance during robust aggregation. Unlike the fault-free case, naively combining non-linear Byzantine-resilient aggregation with central DP noise can be insufficient to guarantee convergence to a bounded neighborhood of a stationary point. Our key contribution is a server-side momentum that leverages a property specific to user-level DP, where privacy sensitivity depends on how client updates are constructed, to empower convergence. ByzULDP achieves the order-optimal convergence bound for strongly-convex objectives, with vanishing error terms decaying at the optimal $O(1/T)$ and $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ rates for strongly-convex and non-convex objectives, respectively. We corroborate our analysis with numerical experiments on real-world datasets across diverse privacy budgets.
arxiv.titleZh: 具有用户级差分隐私的最优拜占庭鲁棒联邦学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 解决拜占庭鲁棒联邦学习在用户级差分隐私下的极小极大最优收敛界这一开放问题。作者先对异构客户端、任意拜占庭鲁棒经验风险最小化问题给出信息论下界，再提出中心化DP算法 ByzULDP:客户端动量抑制鲁棒聚合中的随机梯度方差，而服务端动量利用用户级DP中隐私敏感度取决于客户端更新构造方式这一特性来保证收敛——直接叠加非线性鲁棒聚合与DP噪声不足以收敛到稳定点的有界邻域。该方法在强凸与非凸目标上分别达到最优的 O(1/T) 与 O(1/√T) 收敛率，并在真实数据集、多种隐私预算下用实验验证了分析。
arxiv.reason: 联邦学习+差分隐私的优化理论，与 LLM 方向无交集

arxiv.title: Robust Satisficing Ensemble: Scalable Model Aggregation Under Distribution Shifts
arxiv.abstract: Standard ensemble methods can improve robustness by mitigating individual model stochasticity, but they frequently fail to generalize beyond the training distribution, leaving systems vulnerable to out-of-distribution (OOD) data. We introduce the Robust Satisficing Ensemble (RSE), a scalable probabilistic aggregation framework designed to secure model combinations by minimizing their fragility against distributional changes. By bridging a robust satisficing objective with a quadratic risk surrogate, RSE derives an analytical inner adversary. This fundamental reformulation enables highly efficient weight updates without the computational bottleneck of standard minimax optimization, crucially decoupling optimization complexity from sample size to scale effectively to large datasets. In particular, we prove a geometrically decaying truncation error for the fragility approximation via Lagrange-Burmann expansion and establish stationarity guarantees for RSE. We evaluate RSE across a comprehensive spectrum of distribution shifts, including adversarial label shift (SST-5, TREC), natural subpopulation and temporal shifts (CivilComments, HuffPost). Our results demonstrate that RSE consistently outperforms strong robust baselines, including GroupDRO, IRM, and SRM. These findings establish RSE as a practical, theoretically grounded safeguard for reliable model aggregation in dynamic environments.
arxiv.titleZh: 鲁棒满足性集成：分布偏移下的可扩展模型聚合
arxiv.summaryZh: 标准集成方法能缓解单个模型的随机性，却难以泛化到训练分布之外，使系统在OOD数据上表现脆弱。RSE将鲁棒满足目标与二次风险代理相结合，推导出解析形式的内层对手，绕开标准minimax优化的计算瓶颈，使优化复杂度与样本量解耦，可扩展到大规模数据集；理论上借助Lagrange-Bürmann展开证明脆弱性近似的截断误差按几何级数衰减，并给出平稳性保证。在对抗标签偏移（SST-5、TREC）与自然子群、时间偏移（CivilComments、HuffPost）上，RSE稳定优于GroupDRO、IRM、SRM等强鲁棒基线。该工作为动态环境下的可靠模型聚合提供了有理论支撑的实用方案。
arxiv.reason: 分布偏移下的集成鲁棒聚合，属通用ML，非LLM主线

arxiv.title: Complementarity without ground truth?
arxiv.abstract: Human-AI complementarity captures the idea that a human assisted by an AI system can outperform both the human and the AI acting alone. In prediction tasks, this improvement is assessed against ground truth labels produced through a reference construction procedure and intended to represent the state of affairs to be predicted. Many human-AI interactions, including those where medical AI provides treatment recommendations, however, concern tasks other than predicting what obtains. Their relevant output concerns adequacy relative to a practical goal and depends on several evaluative dimensions. In this work, we examine the ground truth dependence of complementarity and extend it to human-AI interactions where ground truth is not the appropriate reference. We show that tasks beyond prediction can still admit a reference construction procedure that generates adequacy labels. We develop a route for extending complementarity to such settings. It replaces ground truth labels with context-dependent adequacy labels generated through a two-step scoring methodology inspired by multi-criteria decision analysis frameworks in healthcare and it makes the normative choices underlying reference construction explicit. Because the construction of adequacy labels embeds evaluative choices, we draw methodological inspiration from computational reliabilism to identify technical, scientific, and social factors relevant to supporting their construction. Our approach expands the empirical study of human-AI complementarity beyond prediction tasks, enabling its quantitative evaluation in decision-support settings where ground truth is not the appropriate evaluative reference.
arxiv.titleZh: 没有真实标签时的互补性？
arxiv.summaryZh: 人类-AI 互补性通常以参照程序产出的真实标签为基准衡量，但医疗治疗推荐等决策支持任务的输出并不预测既成事实，其“恰当性”取决于多个评价维度。该工作用借鉴医疗多准则决策分析的两步打分法生成依赖情境的“恰当性标签”以替代真实标签，并显式化参照构建背后的规范性选择，再借计算可靠主义识别支撑标签构建的技术、科学与社会因素。由此把互补性的实证研究从预测任务扩展到无真实标签的决策支持场景，使其可定量评估，适用于医疗等高风险人机协作的评测设计。
arxiv.reason: 人机互补性评测方法论，偏医疗决策支持，与 LLM 主线关联弱

arxiv.title: Approximate Recall, Approximate Forecasts: Recall as a Diagnostic for LLM Forecasting Errors
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit approximate recall: they retain coarse associations about past events while losing fidelity on specific details. Past research on LLMs has quantified different models' forecasting ability in real-world events using prediction markets, but has not studied how losing said fidelity impacts their forecasting abilities. For example: while an LLM correctly recalls that the answer to: ''Did Anna Sawai win the Best Drama Actress in the 76th Emmy Awards?'' is ''Yes,'' it incorrectly states the event date as September 22 rather than September 15. In this paper, we introduce a novel metric called the Recall Fidelity Score to study how imprecision in internalized knowledge propagates to forecasting capability on future events. On resolved historical markets, we find that higher local recall fidelity around semantically similar past events predicts lower forecasting error on resolved markets, and the same signal predicts smaller distance from open markets prices.
arxiv.comment: 16 pages, 7 figures (including appendix). Accepted as a Spotlight at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Forecasting as a New Frontier of Intelligence
arxiv.titleZh: 近似回忆，近似预测:把回忆作为 LLM 预测误差的诊断指标
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM 存在「近似回忆」现象:对过往事件保留粗粒度关联，但细节失真(例如记对了获奖结果却答错日期)。为此提出 Recall Fidelity Score，用来度量模型对内部知识的局部保真度，并考察这种不精确如何传导到未来事件的预测上。在已结算的历史预测市场问题上，语义相近历史事件周围的局部回忆保真度越高，预测误差越低;该信号也能预测模型报价与开放市场价格之间的偏离更小。该指标可作为预测能力的诊断工具，用于模型选择与可靠性评估。
arxiv.reason: LLM 预测与回忆保真度评测，选题有趣但属 workshop 级增量

arxiv.title: Keeping LLM Agents on Procedure: Executable Finite-State Control for Long-Horizon Instruction Fidelity
arxiv.abstract: Much of the automation handed to language-model agents is procedural: each step needs little intelligence, but a long unattended run must follow a skill or SOP stated once at the start. We show that agents drift from such procedures over long runs, and that restating the instructions or resuming a stopped agent only moves the drift to another shortcut. We study an executable finite-state machine (FSM) that keeps the workflow state outside the model's context and enforces it at three points: tool calls, state transitions and the end of the agent's turn. In a pre-registered experiment on 200-account SOP-Bench batches, Claude Haiku 4.5 with the FSM decided on average 139 accounts correctly and by the procedure, against 48 for the strongest baseline (95% CI of the difference [46, 130]), and kept this rate to the end; across three models, the gain tracked how much the plain agent drifted. Because the runtime, not the model, supplies this long-horizon reliability, the FSM can let small models carry procedural work: Haiku 4.5 with it averaged more such decisions than plain Claude Sonnet 4.6 at 38% of the cost. Analyses on SWE-bench Verified, $τ^2$-bench, and staged and cross-context workflows further suggest that reliable long-horizon automation can come from stronger execution control, not only stronger models.
arxiv.titleZh: 让 LLM Agent 守住流程：面向长程指令保真度的可执行有限状态控制
arxiv.summaryZh: 在长程无人值守运行时，LLM agent 会偏离开头一次性给出的 SOP；重述指令或重启 agent 只是把漂移换成另一种捷径。该方法把工作流状态移出模型上下文，用可执行有限状态机（FSM）在工具调用、状态转移与回合结束三处强制流程。在预注册的 SOP-Bench 200 账户批次实验中，搭载 FSM 的 Claude Haiku 4.5 平均正确按流程决策 139 个账户，而最强基线仅 48（95% CI [46, 130]），并且该比率保持到任务末尾。其正确决策数超过原生 Sonnet 4.6，成本仅为后者的 38%。SWE-bench Verified、$\tau^2$-bench 与跨上下文流程的分析显示，长程自动化可靠性可来自更强的执行控制，而不只是更强的模型。
arxiv.reason: 聚焦 Agent 流程保真与执行控制，实验扎实且有成本对比

arxiv.title: Robust and Efficient Continual Model Merging via Global Singular Subspace Separation and Restoration
arxiv.abstract: Continual model merging incrementally integrates task-specific models without revisiting past models or data. However, repeated merging entangles past task components and distorts their singular geometry, making balanced task-wise allocation increasingly difficult. We propose Global Singular Subspace Separation and Restoration (GS3R), which augments the merged update with a compact restoration state. At each merge, GS3R restores the retained singular geometry, separates task-wise subspaces, and globally reallocates the available rank across tasks fairly. To reduce merging-time memory overhead, we further introduce Pre-merge Restoration and Flushing (PRF). Experiments on vision, NLP, and multimodal benchmarks show that GS3R provides a strong accuracy-efficiency trade-off.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过全局奇异子空间分离与恢复实现鲁棒高效的持续模型合并
arxiv.summaryZh: 持续模型合并按序整合任务模型，无需重访历史模型或数据，但反复合并会纠缠已有任务分量并扭曲其奇异几何，使任务间容量分配趋于失衡。GS3R为合并后的更新附加一个紧凑的恢复状态:每次合并时恢复被保留的奇异几何、分离各任务子空间，并在全局范围内公平地重新分配可用秩;同时提出 Pre-merge Restoration and Flushing(PRF)降低合并时的显存开销。在视觉、NLP与多模态基准上取得较强的精度—效率折中，适用于模型复用与多任务能力叠加场景。
arxiv.reason: 持续模型合并方法，与后训练/效率沾边但非核心方向

arxiv.title: BRAT: Bounded Residual-Aligned Training for Stable Multi-Pass LLM Post-Training
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning for large language model post-training often reuses each batch of sampled rollouts for several gradient passes to amortize the cost of generation. Under such multi-pass reuse, existing objectives fail in different ways: unclipped updates collapse as the policy drifts away from the sampling policy, adding a negative baseline avoids collapse but reinforces every sampled response, and PPO-style ratio clipping cuts off gradients abruptly. We first ask why reuse is fragile. Measuring how well an update estimated from a small rollout group aligns with the KL-regularized target on held-out rollouts of the same prompts, we find that this alignment drops by nearly an order of magnitude from in-sample to held-out rollouts across three base models, suggesting that repeated passes largely overfit the sampled group. Motivated by this finding, we propose Bounded Residual-Aligned Training (BRAT), motivated by a proximal update toward a bounded reweighting of the sampling policy. BRAT assigns each token a gradient weight that decreases linearly with its probability ratio and vanishes at a trust-region boundary, and normalizes group-centered rewards by their maximum magnitude, keeping advantages zero-mean and bounded without extra hyperparameters. With four reuse passes, BRAT avoids training collapse, limits policy drift, and achieves higher average accuracy with lower seed variance on most benchmarks.
arxiv.titleZh: BRAT:面向稳定多轮 LLM 后训练的有界残差对齐训练
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM 强化学习后训练常把同一批采样 rollout 复用做多次梯度更新以摊薄生成成本，但现有目标在此设定下均失效:无裁剪更新随策略漂移而崩溃，加负基线虽避免崩溃却强化了所有采样回复，PPO 式 ratio clipping 则会突然截断梯度。作者先在三个基座模型上测量「小 rollout 组估计的更新」与 KL 正则目标在相同 prompt 的留出 rollout 上的对齐度，发现从 in-sample 到 held-out 下降近一个数量级，说明重复 pass 主要在过拟合采样组。据此提出 BRAT:按概率比线性递减地给每个 token 分配梯度权重并在信任域边界处归零，同时用 group-centered reward 的最大幅度做归一化，使优势零均值、有界且无需额外超参。在四次复用 pass 下，BRAT 避免训练崩溃、限制策略漂移，并在多数 benchmark 上取得更高平均准确率与更低种子方差。
arxiv.reason: 多轮复用下的 RL 目标重设计，直接命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: Online Imitation Learning for Stabilizing Vlasov--Poisson Plasmas
arxiv.abstract: We study the problem of controlling instability in the Vlasov--Poisson plasma systems, a fundamental challenge for nuclear fusion control. Motivated by the partial observability of plasma states in practice, we investigate imitation learning algorithms that learn from a fully-observable expert controller, but operate under macroscopic measurements. We theoretically establish a separation between online and offline imitation learning --- even a small behavior cloning error leads to error compounding that exponentially amplifies instability over time. By way of contrast, the online imitation learning loss can polynomially control the stability of rollout trajectories. We then propose a DAgger-style algorithm that learns the stabilizing controller under partial observability. Simulation results on a 1D Vlasov--Poisson system demonstrate that our algorithm can effectively stabilize plasma instabilities over longer time horizons than behavior cloning.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 43 pages, 9 figures, 2 tables
arxiv.titleZh: 面向Vlasov--Poisson等离子体稳定化的在线模仿学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究Vlasov--Poisson等离子体系统的不稳定性控制问题：实际只能获得宏观测量、状态部分可观测，而专家控制器基于全观测。理论上证明在线与离线模仿学习存在本质分离——即使很小的行为克隆误差也会随时间指数放大导致失稳，而在线模仿学习损失可多项式地控制 rollout 轨迹的稳定性。据此提出部分可观测条件下的 DAgger 式稳定控制算法，在一维 Vlasov--Poisson 系统上比行为克隆在更长时域内有效抑制等离子体不稳定性。
arxiv.reason: 等离子体控制与核聚变应用，偏离LLM关注方向

arxiv.title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Deleting Weights in LLM Post-Training
arxiv.abstract: How little of a pretrained large language model (LLM) has to change for it to acquire new capabilities? We find that zeroing fewer than 0.05% of its weights, with no other modification, matches full fine-tuning (FFT) at scale across three LLM post-training regimes: reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, supervised fine-tuning, and on-policy distillation. Our method, Deletion Tuning, learns a binary mask over the gate projection of transformer blocks. Two practical advantages follow: the trained mask is hundreds to thousands of times smaller than the corresponding FFT checkpoint, and Deletion Tuning forgets far less, which addresses a central challenge in continual learning. Under reinforcement learning, its prior-task accuracy stays near the base level while FFT, LoRA, and random sparse fine-tuning lose up to 5.4 points.
