To understand why masking alone suffices, we analyze the geometry of the learned weight changes under reinforcement learning using stable rank, spectrum drift, and principal-weight overlap. Compared with LoRA and random sparse fine-tuning, Deletion Tuning is closest to FFT across the three measures.
arxiv.titleZh: 删除权重在LLM后训练中的惊人有效性
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对后训练是否必须大幅改动预训练权重这一问题，提出Deletion Tuning：仅将Transformer各块gate projection中不到0.05%的权重置零，学习一个二值掩码，其余参数完全不动，在可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）、监督微调和on-policy蒸馏三种后训练范式下均能匹配全量微调（FFT）的效果。训练得到的掩码比对应的FFT检查点小数百至数千倍，且灾难性遗忘显著更轻：在强化学习场景下，其旧任务准确率保持在基座水平附近，而FFT、LoRA与随机稀疏微调最多下降5.4分。作者进一步用stable rank、谱漂移和主权重重叠度分析RL下权重变化的几何结构，发现Deletion Tuning在三项指标上都最接近FFT，为「稀疏删除即可承载新能力」提供了机制性解释。
arxiv.reason: 后训练新范式，方法简洁、结果强，直接命中关注方向

arxiv.title: Stochastic Port-Hamiltonian Gaussian Processes for Learning from Noisy Dynamics on Lie Groups
arxiv.abstract: Learning predictive models for dynamics is difficult because observations are often sparse and noisy, while the underlying dynamics evolve on nonlinear configuration manifolds and are affected by environmental dissipation and stochastic disturbances. Standard neural dynamics models can fit short-term trajectories but often violate physical structure, accumulate error over long horizons, or rely on parameterizations that introduce singularities such as gimbal lock. We introduce LieSPHGP, a stochastic Gaussian-process framework for learning rigid body dynamics with port-Hamiltonian structure and stability-aware robustness. LieSPHGP represents motion on Lie groups and Lie algebras, enabling coordinate-consistent optimization without singular parameterizations. Learned mass, potential energy, dissipation, and control components retain physical roles and a separate diffusion term represents stochastic forcing. Each component is modeled by Matérn kernel Gaussian processes which capture uncertainty induced by noisy observations. To improve physical validity, Lie group exponential map updates preserve rotational constraints, while positive-definite damping ensures nonnegative deterministic energy dissipation. The implicit-explicit integrator additionally provides unconditional stability for the frozen linear damping subsystem. The resulting model learns predictive dynamics that are robust to noise, respect rigid body geometry, and capture both intrinsic motion and environmental dissipation. Experiments on various noisy rigid body benchmarks show improved prediction accuracy, stronger long-horizon stability, and better satisfaction of manifold constraints compared with neural dynamics baselines. Code, data and interactive results are available on the project website: https://thribhuvanrapolu.github.io/liesphgp/
arxiv.titleZh: 用于从李群上含噪动力学中学习的随机 port-Hamiltonian 高斯过程
arxiv.summaryZh: 刚性体动力学的观测通常稀疏含噪，而运动发生在非线性流形上，并受耗散与随机扰动影响;常规神经动力学模型虽能拟合短期轨迹，却易破坏物理结构、在长时程上累积误差，或依赖万向锁之类带奇异性的参数化。LieSPHGP 在 Lie 群与 Lie 代数上表示运动，实现无奇异、坐标一致的优化，并将质量、势能、耗散与控制分量各自保留物理角色，以独立扩散项刻画随机强迫，每个分量用 Matérn 核高斯过程建模以表达观测噪声带来的不确定性。方法借助 Lie 群指数映射更新保持旋转约束，用正定阻尼保证确定性能量耗散非负，并以隐显式积分器为冻结的线性阻尼子系统提供无条件稳定性。在多个含噪刚性体基准上，该框架相对神经动力学基线取得更高预测精度、更强的长时程稳定性与更好的流形约束满足度。
arxiv.reason: 刚性体动力学与流形上的 GP 建模，属机器人与经典方法，与 LLM 关注方向无关

arxiv.title: SWXAI: A Unified Multimodal Explainability Library for Space Weather Forecasting and Heliophysics
arxiv.abstract: Space weather forecasting and heliophysics increasingly rely on machine learning models that process heterogeneous inputs such as multi-viewpoint multi-wavelength solar images and rasters, multivariate time series, spatial annotations, and tabular event-level data. However, explainability workflows remain fragmented across libraries, model interfaces, and output formats, limiting reuse and reproducibility. We present SWXAI, an open-source library that unifies explainable AI (XAI) workflows for image, time-series, and tabular data in space weather forecasting and heliophysics. SWXAI provides a common, extensible interface across commonly used vision, time-series, and tabular learning models, with validation, adaptation, and persistent explanation objects. It also includes domain-grounded examples, reproducible notebooks, tests, and documentation, enabling users to inspect outputs, swap models or explainers, and extend workflows to new heliophysics datasets. SWXAI reduces modality-specific engineering overhead and supports comparable, reusable explanations across heterogeneous scientific machine learning pipelines. A benchmark against direct backend implementations shows that SWXAI substantially reduces the code users write to produce an explanation, with no practical runtime cost.

arxiv.summaryZh: 空间天气预报与太阳物理模型需要处理多视角多波段太阳图像、栅格、多变量时间序列、空间标注与事件级表格等异构输入，但可解释性流程分散在不同库、模型接口与输出格式中，复用与可复现性受限。SWXAI 为图像、时间序列与表格三类数据提供统一且可扩展的 XAI 接口，涵盖常用视觉、时序与表格模型，并支持校验、适配与可持久化的解释对象，同时附带领域示例、可复现 notebook、测试与文档，用户可替换模型或解释器并扩展到新数据集。与直接调用后端实现的基准对比显示，SWXAI 大幅减少生成解释所需的用户代码量，且几乎不增加运行时开销。该工作适用于异构科学机器学习流水线中的可解释性工程，但领域局限于空间天气。

arxiv.title: Structurally Separated DAG Learning with Multi-Scale Normalized Closure
arxiv.abstract: Continuous DAG learning commonly enforces acyclicity through scalar functions of a weighted adjacency that aggregate evidence from weighted closed walks. We add a complementary layer: matrix-valued closure logits---explicit multi-hop structural relation scores for each ordered pair---supervised alongside data fit, sparsity, and a DAGMA-style barrier on the weighted adjacency. The distinction is not scalarization of the overall objective but how path evidence is represented and exposed before aggregation. SMNC (scale-normalized multi-scale closure) builds these scores on a structural gate by repeated squaring in log space and divides each scale by its path-length budget, counteracting product-style attenuation along long cycles; diagonal entries support node-wise cycle supervision and off-diagonals optional pairwise reachability cues. In the linear model, a bounded structure--magnitude factorization ties strong effective edges to strong gates; a nonlinear induced gate offers another construction with the same intent. For sufficiently strong cycles, normalized logits admit a length-independent lower bound; under a unique-active-cycle assumption, the hard final-scale readout yields a polynomial log-gate gradient factor rather than exponential product-style decay. On cue-free, unstandardized Gaussian linear and nonlinear ER benchmarks, these models improve over DAGMA, run with default hyperparameters at a reduced budget, on denser graphs and are close to it on sparse ones.
arxiv.titleZh: 结构分离的DAG学习与多尺度归一化闭包
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对连续DAG学习中仅用加权邻接的标量函数约束无环性的局限，SMNC在数据拟合、稀疏项与DAGMA式障碍之外，引入矩阵值闭包logits，对每个有序节点对显式建模多跳结构关系并施加监督。其核心是在对数空间反复平方构造结构门，并按路径长度预算对每个尺度归一化，以缓解长环路径证据的乘积式衰减；线性模型用有界结构—幅度分解绑定强有效边与强门控，最终尺度读出可在唯一活跃环假设下给出多项式对数门梯度因子。在无先验、未标准化的高斯线性与非线性ER基准上，该方法以默认超参和更小预算运行，在稠密图上优于DAGMA，在稀疏图上接近DAGMA。

arxiv.title: Polynomial Denoisers on the Image Manifold: Volterra Networks for Self-Contained Pixel Diffusion
arxiv.abstract: Natural images are often conjectured to lie on a low-dimensional manifold within the high-dimensional pixel space. Recent work leverages this to build self-contained pixel-space diffusion models without specialized machinery or pretrained components. A plain Transformer on raw image patches suffices, provided it predicts the clean image rather than the noise and compresses each patch through an aggressive bottleneck. The mixing operator, however, has remained softmax attention, inherited from sequence modeling rather than derived from denoising. For Gaussian noise, the optimal denoiser admits a canonical expansion in polynomial functionals of the observation, the Wiener--Volterra series. We prove that softmax attention, and any normalized mixing rule (including linear attention), cannot realize any polynomial map beyond an affine one. In contrast, Volterra layers realize this class directly and, on a data manifold, achieve approximation rates governed by the manifold dimension rather than the ambient pixel dimension. We therefore propose the architecture these results prescribe; raw image patches passed through a bottleneck embedding, followed by cascaded low-rank Volterra layers, which carry no activation function because each layer is nonlinear in its own right. To our knowledge this is the first pixel-space diffusion architecture whose mixing operators are Volterra layers throughout, with no attention, no convolution, no pretrained components, and no activation function on the residual path. On ImageNet $256 \times 256$ and $512 \times 512$, the resulting model is competitive with self-contained pixel-space diffusion at matched parameter and FLOP budgets.
arxiv.titleZh: 图像流形上的多项式去噪器：用于自包含像素扩散的 Volterra 网络
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对自包含像素扩散仍以 softmax 注意力作为混合算子、而非从高斯去噪推导的问题，证明 softmax 注意力及任意归一化混合规则（含线性注意力）只能实现仿射多项式映射。据此构建图像流形上的 Volterra 网络：原始图像块经瓶颈嵌入后进入级联低秩 Volterra 层，每层自身非线性，残差路径不含激活函数、注意力、卷积或预训练组件。理论表明 Volterra 层可直接实现 Wiener–Volterra 展开，其近似率由流形维度而非像素维度控制。在 ImageNet 256×256 与 512×512 上，匹配参数量与 FLOPs 时性能与自包含像素扩散模型相当。

arxiv.title: Self-contained Data Cleaning for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
arxiv.abstract: Training datasets for unsupervised anomaly detection are often assumed to be anomaly-free, but in practice, they frequently contain malicious or anomalous contamination. This contamination severely degrades the dependability and security of downstream detection models. While some contamination-robust methods exist, they rarely generalize across different model architectures and typically rely on a priori knowledge of the contamination ratio\textemdash information that is rarely available in real-world security operations. In this paper, we propose a novel, self-contained preprocessing framework for anomaly detection that identifies and removes training set contamination without relying on known contamination ratios. Our approach performs a dynamic analysis of the cosine similarity between each data point and its reconstruction during the early training stages of an auto-encoder, mapping points into a dynamic space where anomalous regions naturally exhibit lower density. By executing ``hard cleaning''\textemdash removing all identified anomalous candidates from the training pool\textemdash we systematically improve data quality. Because this cleaning occurs at the data level, the security and reliability improvements generalize seamlessly across various downstream anomaly detection architectures. Evaluating our framework across 8 distinct models and 10 security-relevant datasets, our approach achieves up to 100\% contamination reduction, yielding average improvements of 11.2\% in F1 score and 7.3\% in classification accuracy.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向无监督异常检测的自包含数据清洗
arxiv.summaryZh: 无监督异常检测的训练集常被默认无污染，实际却混有恶意或异常样本，而现有抗污染方法依赖已知污染比例、难以跨模型架构泛化。该工作在自编码器训练早期动态分析每个样本与其重建结果之间的余弦相似度，把样本映射到异常区域密度更低的动态空间中，再执行「硬清洗」，即把识别出的异常候选全部移出训练池，从而在数据层面提升质量。在 8 个模型与 10 个安全相关数据集上，污染去除率最高达 100%,F1 平均提升 11.2%，分类准确率平均提升 7.3%，且改进可无缝迁移到不同下游检测架构。
arxiv.reason: 面向安全异常检测的数据清洗，与 LLM 主线无交集，仅沾数据质量边

arxiv.title: Representing Tensors as Compositions for Efficient Computation on Sparse and Structured Data
arxiv.abstract: We propose a new mathematical formalism in which all kinds of tensors and of operations on those tensors are represented as simple function compositions. Tensors are functions from indices to values. An element-wise operation (e.g. an activation function) is a composition with a function applied to values; re-indexing (e.g. reshape, transposition) is a composition with a function applied to indices; and a reduction is a composition with both an index function, mapping each index to several indices, and a reduction operation (e.g. product, sum, max). Combined with tensor stacking, these compositions can represent most interesting kinds of tensors (e.g. dense, jagged, all kinds of sparsity patterns, matrix factorizations), as well as lazy versions of almost every operation available in modern tensor computation frameworks, including einsums between tensors of any kind. Identities between compositions can then be used to rewrite such expressions into equivalent ones, without evaluating them. For instance, the product of two sparse matrices can be rewritten so that only products between non-zero values are computed, turning a sparse problem into a dense one. Using this algebra as the intermediate representation of a tensor computation engine would shift the focus from defining operations on tensors (e.g. einsum between sparse tensors) to defining an algebra on index functions. This should reduce the codebase complexity from $\mathcal{O}(mn^2)$, with $m$ the number of binary operations between tensors and $n$ the number of tensor types, to $\mathcal{O}(m + k^2)$, with $k$ the number of types of index functions. A draft implementation of a tensor computation framework based on this algebra is publicly available.
arxiv.titleZh: 将张量表示为函数复合以实现稀疏与结构化数据上的高效计算
arxiv.summaryZh: 张量计算框架通常要为每种张量类型与运算的组合单独实现，代码量随张量类型数 n 与二元运算数 m 呈 O(mn²) 增长。该工作把张量视为从索引到值的函数，将逐元素运算、重索引与归约统一表示为函数复合，并结合张量堆叠覆盖稠密、jagged、各类稀疏模式与矩阵分解，以及任意张量间 einsum 的惰性版本。利用复合恒等式可在不求值的情况下重写表达式，例如把稀疏矩阵乘积改写为只计算非零值之间的乘积，从而将稀疏问题转为稠密问题。若作为张量计算引擎的中间表示，复杂度可降至 O(m+k²)，其中 k 为索引函数类型数。
arxiv.reason: 张量编译与稀疏计算形式化，与系统效率方向擦边

arxiv.title: KeyASRBench: Measuring Whole-Phrase Keyword Preservation in Real-World ASR
arxiv.abstract: Public automatic speech recognition (ASR) benchmarks increasingly report low sequence error rates, yet production systems still use hotword lists, contextual biasing, retrieval, and post-correction. This motivates a complementary question: does a transcript preserve selected names, products, technical terms, versions, and relational phrases? We present KeyASRBench, a bilingual pilot that operationalizes occurrence-based Keyword Error Rate (KER) over frozen whole-phrase annotations. The 10-hour model-conditioned challenge set contains 1,501 Chinese and English clips with 4,723 keyword occurrences. Across five locally inferred checkpoints and two official API systems, language-specific MER/WER ranges from 5.31% to 12.91%, while KER ranges from 13.61% to 33.81%. A disjoint 30-minute model-blind control yields KER of 10.65%-27.31%. The control confirms that selected-phrase errors extend beyond challenge-set selection.
arxiv.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Bilingual ASR evaluation with a 10-hour model-conditioned challenge set and a disjoint 30-minute model-blind control
arxiv.titleZh: KeyASRBench：衡量真实场景 ASR 中整句关键词的保留程度
arxiv.summaryZh: 公开 ASR benchmark 的序列错误率持续走低，但生产系统仍依赖热词表、上下文偏置、检索与后处理，因此需要回答：转写是否保留了特定人名、产品名、术语、版本号与关系短语？KeyASRBench 基于冻结的整句标注，构建以出现次数计的关键词错误率（KER）。10 小时模型条件挑战集包含 1,501 条中英文片段、4,723 次关键词出现；在五个本地推理 checkpoint 与两个官方 API 上，分语种 MER/WER 为 5.31%–12.91%，而 KER 高达 13.61%–33.81%。另设互不重叠的 30 分钟 model-blind 对照集，KER 为 10.65%–27.31%，说明关键词错误并非仅由挑战集筛选造成。
